title: Dialpad vs Telegram
description: Dialpad vs Telegram: Telegram is our overall pick for Communication teams — Dialpad 4.3/5, Telegram 4.4/5; Dialpad from $15-35/mo, Telegram from Free
verdict: Telegram emerges as the winner in this comparison based on overall feature depth, user satisfaction ratings, and value for money in the Communication category. While both platforms are strong contenders, Telegram offers the better balance of features, pricing, and user experience for most use cases.

faqs.question: Which is better for small teams, Dialpad or Telegram?
faqs.answer: For small teams, the choice often comes down to ease of setup and pricing. Dialpad tends to be more intuitive for new users, while Telegram offers more advanced features that smaller teams may not need immediately. Consider your team's technical comfort level and growth plans.

faqs.question: Can Dialpad and Telegram be integrated?
faqs.answer: Both platforms offer API access and integration capabilities, making it possible to use them together if needed. However, most teams find it more efficient to standardize on one platform to avoid data duplication and workflow fragmentation.
